# Supabase browser client

Supabase JavaScript 2.119.0, copied without modification from the official npm package.

Source: https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js

License: [MIT](./supabase-LICENSE.txt).

Run `npm ci` and `npm run vendor` after changing the pinned package version. Keeping this file local allows the app shell and cached accounts to open offline without a CDN.
